tournamentsOverview.title: Tournaments
tournamentsOverview.description: Trade the leaderboard, not just the market. Join a tournament, get a fresh stack of chips, and climb the board against everyone else entered — top finishers split a real prize pool.
tournamentsOverview.step1Body: No separate sign-up — join from your account with any entry fee the tournament asks for, or free.
tournamentsOverview.step2Title: Trade a fresh stack of chips
tournamentsOverview.step2Body: A tournament balance never mixes with your practice or live money. Trade it exactly like a live account.
tournamentsOverview.step3Body: The leaderboard ranks every entrant by chip balance in real time, until the tournament ends.
tournamentsOverview.step4Body: Prizes are paid out by finishing position once the tournament closes, straight to your live balance.
tournamentsOverview.empty: Nothing scheduled at the moment — new tournaments are announced regularly. Create an account to be notified when one opens.

statusLevels.title: Status levels
statusLevels.description: The more you trade, the more you keep. Status is based on your lifetime deposits and is applied automatically — no forms to fill in, no request to make.
statusLevels.notEnabled: Status levels are not currently active on this platform.
statusLevels.howCalculatedBody: Your level is based on how much you have deposited in total, ever — not your balance, and not what you have traded. It only ever moves up.
statusLevels.payoutBonusBody: It is applied to your own position from your level alone. The market's own payout is unchanged, and nothing about it depends on what you or anyone else is trading.

affiliate.title: Affiliate programme
affiliate.description: Earn {{pct}}% of what the traders you refer deposit — for as long as they keep trading. No approval process, no minimum audience.
affiliate.step1Body: Every account gets its own referral code, ready to share from day one.
affiliate.step2Body: Send it to anyone — friends, a community, a following. There is no cap on how many people you can refer.
affiliate.step3Body: A commission on what they deposit lands in your own balance automatically, no monthly claim or minimum.
affiliate.commissionBody: There is nothing to apply for and nothing to claim: once someone registers with your link and deposits, your commission is credited automatically. Your own account page shows every trader you've referred and what you've earned from each of them.

about.title: About Quantex
about.intro1: Quantex is a fixed-payout trading platform: pick a direction, set a stake, and know your exact profit before you trade. We built it around one idea — a trader should be able to see the whole shape of a decision, the risk and the reward, before they make it.
about.intro2: The platform covers currencies, crypto, commodities, stocks and indices, including broker-priced OTC markets that trade around the clock. Every account starts with a free practice balance on the same engine as live trading, so there is a real way to learn the platform before any money is at risk.
about.value1Title: Prices belong to the market, not to your position
about.value1Body: Our pricing engine never reads a trade, a position or an exposure to decide where a quote goes. What you are holding never moves the price of what you are holding.
about.value2Title: Know the payout before you commit
about.value2Body: Every trade shows its exact payout percentage before you confirm it, and that figure is locked in the moment your position opens — not adjusted after the fact.
about.value3Body: The practice account runs on the same engine, the same prices and the same terminal as live trading. What you learn there is what you will actually see.
about.riskTitle: A serious risk warning, not a footnote
about.riskBody: Fixed-payout trading is high-risk. You can lose your entire stake on a single trade, and past results never guarantee future ones. We put the risk warning where you'll actually read it — on every public page and in the terminal itself — because a platform that hides the downside is not one we would want to trade on either.
